# Procedure

Trace routing, ActionForm scope/reset/validation, forwards, custom dispatcher and JSP/JSTL/taglibs. Confirm session/concurrent request behaviour and output encoding. Test invalid, missing and unauthorised inputs. Update only affected mappings; preserve servlet descriptor levels.

# Contract

Read docs/STACK.md and the selected change inputs. Preserve source/requirement references. Persist outputs to changes/CHANGE-ID. Use templates where relevant. Do not modify controls or self-approve. Report blockers with the decision needed and affected artifacts.
